messages:
Alex (Finance): Noticed a weird split on the Apr GCP reseller settlement: two lines for the same reseller invoice, one shows seats transferred (12 seats) and a tax line of $1,980, other shows seats removed with tax -$1,980. Net zero for tax but ledger can't map both to same subscription id. Anyone seen this pattern?
Priya (Billing): Hmm that sounds like the seat-migration flow where the reseller moves seats between customers. Usually we get a migrate_event with subscription_id. Do you have the settlement row?
Alex (Finance): Attached snippet in the ticket: invoice RSR-2024-04-1029, lines:
```
line 45: reseller_redwood,sub_transfer,RS-ALT-009,quantity:12,amount:1200.00,tax:1980.00
line 46: reseller_redwood,sub_remove,RS-ALT-009,quantity:-12,amount:-1200.00,tax:-1980.00
```
Alex (Finance): No subscription_id present, only a partner_reference 'RS-ALT-009'. Our reconciler expects subscription_id to apply revenue move.
Tom (Sales Ops): That's our new reseller portal flow — partner references the internal order id, but GCP sometimes omits subscription_id in the settlement payload. We asked partners to include mapping in a supplemental manifest. Did the partner submit one?
Nina (Accounting): If we can't map, accounting rules say we can't move revenue between customer ledgers without proof. We need partner confirmation that this was a seat migration and not an adjustment requiring refund.
BillingBot: New settlement file imported: GCP-SETTLEMENT-2024-04-30. Reconciler WARNING: duplicate offset lines for order RS-ALT-009.
Priya (Billing): Proposed action: put invoice RSR-2024-04-1029 on hold for payout, open a support case with reseller to request the migration manifest (subscription ids before/after) and ask for the original purchase timestamps.
Tom (Sales Ops): I'll ping the reseller account team. Quick message draft: "We see offsetting transfer/remove lines for RS-ALT-009 in your GCP settlement. Please provide the migration manifest or confirm target subscription IDs so we can apply revenue reallocation. If you cannot provide mapping within 72h, we will treat the net effect as a reseller-level adjustment and post a contra per policy."
Alex (Finance): Sounds good. Also flag tax team: we need to ensure tax isn't double-posted in tax payable account during the hold. Nina, can you prepare a temporary tax reserve entry?
Nina (Accounting): Yes — I'll draft a reserve JE to hold the $1,980 tax liability until mapping is confirmed. If partner confirms it's a true migration we reclassify; if it's an erroneous offset we reverse.
Priya (Billing): I've flagged the reconciler to ignore mirrored +/- lines with identical partner_reference until manual review. But we should avoid silencing legitimate refunds. Will add rule only for exact partner_reference duplicates within same settlement file.
Alex (Finance): Good guardrail. Also request Sales Ops include partner_contact and partner_manifest link in future onboarding checklist.
Tom (Sales Ops): On it. I'll add to the reseller onboarding ticket and follow up with the rep.
Priya (Billing): I've put a hold on payout for RSR-2024-04-1029 and annotated the AR entry. Will revisit after reseller reply.
BillingBot: Case created: CASE-56721 (partner_manifest_request) assigned to Sales Ops.
Alex (Finance): Thanks all. Please update this thread with partner response. If no reply in 72h, escalate to legal for potential reconciliation apportionment. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
